bio: Faculty at the Industrial Design Centre (IDC), IIT Bombay, working across visual design, interaction design, and design research. Holds a PhD from IIT Bombay on theoretical modeling of Devanagari typefaces. Co-created several Indian-script typefaces, including the Ek multi-script family, the open-source Ek Mukta family, LifeOk Devanagari, and Star Bengali, and contributed font engineering and type design assistance to Baloo 2 Devanagari.

sources.title: Girish Dalvi — IDC School of Design, IIT Bombay
